name: What to Watch: AI Movies & TV

ios.desc:
Stop Scrolling. Start Watching.

Can’t decide what to watch?
What to Watch is the smartest movie recommendation & TV show finder powered by advanced AI.

Find the perfect movie or series in seconds—based on your mood, taste, and preferences.

AI Movie & TV Show Recommendations That Actually Work

Forget endless scrolling. Our next-generation AI analyzes what you like and delivers accurate movie and TV show recommendations instantly.

Looking for:
• A hidden gem
• A trending hit
• A specific vibe or emotion

Deep Search understands exactly what you want to watch right now.

Discover Movies & Series You’ll Love

Search smarter than genre filters.
Try queries like:
“90s action movies with a plot twist”
“dark sci-fi series like Black Mirror”
“feel-good movies for couples”

This is more than a streaming guide — it’s a personal cinema curator.

Why What to Watch Is the Ultimate Movie App

• Couple Match
Swipe together and instantly find a movie you both want to watch. Perfect for date nights.

• AI-Powered Precision
The more you use it, the smarter your recommendations get.

• Mood-Based Matching
Choose movies by emotion, not just category.

• Movie & Series Tracker
Create your watchlist, track what you’ve seen, and never forget a title again.

• Social Cinema
Play the Daily Movie Quiz, climb global leaderboards, and see what’s trending worldwide.

Your All-in-One Streaming Guide

Find where to watch movies and TV shows across popular streaming platforms.
No guessing. No wasted time.

We combine:
• Powerful AI
• Rich movie databases
• Beautiful design

To deliver the best movie recommendation app on the App Store.

Key Features

• Instant movie & TV show recommendations
• Intelligent Deep Search movie finder
• Movie tracker & watchlist manager
• High-quality posters, trailers & visuals
• Cast, crew & rating data powered by TMDb
• Secure & private personal data handling

Join Thousands of Movie Lovers

Stop wasting movie nights.
Start watching something you’ll actually love.

Download What to Watch now and find your next favorite movie today.

android.desc:
What to Watch is an AI-powered movie and TV recommendation app that helps you discover what to watch based on your mood, taste, preferences and the kind of experience you want.

Not sure what movie to watch tonight? Looking for a TV show that fits your taste? Describe what you want in your own words and get personalized recommendations instead of scrolling through endless lists.

🎬 AI MOVIE & TV RECOMMENDATIONS

Get movie and TV recommendations based on:
• Mood, feelings and emotions
• Personal taste and preferences
• Favorite movies and TV shows
• Genres, themes and stories
• Atmosphere and tone
• Actors, characters and eras
• Your likes, skips, favorites and viewing history

🧠 MOOD-BASED MOVIE FINDER

Your mood changes what feels like the right movie.

Find movies and TV shows based on emotions, feelings, energy, atmosphere and the experience you want.

Whether you want something funny, relaxing, emotional, nostalgic, exciting, mysterious, comforting, intense or thought-provoking, describe the feeling and let AI help you find the right match.

🔍 NATURAL LANGUAGE AI SEARCH

You don't need to know the exact genre or title.

Tell What to Watch what you want:
"I want something emotional but not depressing."
"Find a mind-bending sci-fi like Inception."
"Give me an underrated thriller for a rainy night."
"I need something funny to watch with my partner."
"Find a slow-burn series with complex characters."

Search through descriptions of moods, stories, themes, characters, genres, actors, atmosphere, similar movies and specific viewing situations.

🎯 PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS

Go beyond generic top lists and trending titles.

What to Watch can learn from your choices and preferences to make future recommendations more relevant to your personal taste.

The goal is not simply to find a popular movie.

The goal is to find the right movie for you.

🌟 HIDDEN GEMS & UNDERRATED TITLES

Discover hidden gems, underrated movies and overlooked TV shows instead of seeing only the titles everyone already knows.

🎥 FIND MOVIES & SHOWS LIKE YOUR FAVORITES

Start with a movie or TV show you love and discover similar titles based on story, genre, theme, characters, tone and overall feeling.

📺 MOVIES AND TV SHOWS

Discover movies and TV series across genres, decades, themes and styles, from classics and new releases to popular favorites and lesser-known discoveries.

show_hn.title: Show HN: What to Watch AI – Mood-based movie and TV picks in 3 questions

quotes.text:
I built What to Watch AI, a lightweight recommendation app that suggests movies and TV shows based on mood and preferences using just 3 questions.

Why it’s different:

No long onboarding, no accounts

Focused on decision fatigue (couples included)

Fast results, minimal UI

Platforms:

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cine.ai

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/what-to-watch-ai-movies-tv/id6756384424

Looking for honest feedback on recommendation quality and UX.
